_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced. Hosting / infra: no funds, so the value is a takedown of a phishing project and preservation of its records. The contact-us page publishes abuse and legal aliases on supabase.com; they are declared with value null until the catalogue's address list is extended in a reviewed change. No separate LE address is published.
notes: Customer projects are served at <project-ref>.supabase.co: the project ref is the identifier to cite (provider_ids). Ask for preservation before, or together with, a takedown: contact data is kept 60 days after an account closes, and the privacy policy describes a 'legal hold' only where Supabase faces threat of a legal claim. A courtesy preservation request from a private party has no legal force; say so.

entities.name: Supabase Inc
entities.notes: Named in the site footer; the page does not state where it is incorporated.

entities.name: Supabase Pte. Ltd. (data controller for EEA / UK / Swiss users)
entities.notes: Jurisdiction not stated; the policy says data may be transferred to the United States and Singapore.

sibling.purpose: Older domain: the Acceptable Use Policy still names its abuse and legal aliases there

channels.label: Abuse reports (AUP violations: phishing, malware, unlawful activity)
channels.notes: Published on the contact-us page as the abuse alias on supabase.com (the AUP gives it on supabase.io); not yet catalogued as a value: confirm it there and add it as a case channel. Anyone may report.

channels.label: Legal inquiries, formal complaints and regulatory inquiries (Grievance Officer: General Counsel)
channels.notes: Published on the contact-us page as the legal alias on supabase.com; not yet catalogued as a value. Security vulnerabilities go to the security alias, never abuse reports.

supabase.le.notes: No separate law-enforcement address or portal is published (contact-us page): an officer writes to the legal alias. Leave null.

paths.notes: Report the full project URL (*.supabase.co), screenshots, the time observed and why it is fraud. Supabase may investigate, suspend or terminate access (AUP 6.1) and may report suspected illegal activity to law enforcement (AUP 6.2); it has no duty to monitor (6.3). Action and timing are discretionary and undocumented.

instrument.notes: A courtesy preservation request; cite the police / IC3 reference.

paths.notes: Ask Supabase to preserve the project and account records for a stated time window. A legal hold is documented only where Supabase faces threat of a legal claim; whether a third-party request triggers one is not stated.

instrument.notes: The privacy policy discloses to third parties 'as required by law or subpoena' and to comply with 'reasonable requests of law enforcement'.
